Definition: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown)
BiblicalUsage: tsâphôwn is the ordinary word for the north. It appears 141 times in Scripture, including 1 Kings 7:25 and Daniel 11:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâphôwn is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
